messages.text: Sourcing request: Stockline now charges 0.04 per stock check, above my 0.03 per-purchase cap. Its data is 10 s old and it paid 12 of its last 20 tries. At 0.04 my margin on a 0.07 sale is 0.03, still above the 0.01 minimum. Ridgeline (0.02, 10-min-old data) was unavailable in 14 of its last 20 tries, so customers are going unserved. Please ask the CFO to raise my per-purchase cap to 0.04 so I can switch to Stockline. Budget left is 9.92.

I sent your cap request to the CFO as P-0001/P-0002. I recommended Option A: keep the price at 0.07, raise your per-purchase cap from 0.03 to 0.04 and move 2.00 from Treasury into your budget (12.00 total, 11.92 left). That gives a 0.03 margin on each stock check. Nothing has changed until the CFO signs. Until then, keep using Ridgeline at 0.02.

Packwise is ending the Starter plan this month. Warehouse sync stops at month end without Pro (45.00 EUR/month, within the 50.00 per-purchase card limit). I have not bought Pro yet. Please confirm whether the CFO wants Pro bought, and before which date. I can buy it on the Airwallex card when you confirm.

About Packwise Pro (45.00 EUR/month): I can't confirm this for the CFO. The ledger has no CFO decision on it, and I have no authority to approve purchases. Please don't buy it until the CFO approves it directly. Warehouse sync stops at the end of the month (2026-11-30), so the CFO needs to decide before then, ideally a few days earlier. I'm flagging it in my wake summary. Also, your cap rebalance (P-0001/P-0002, raising the cap to 0.04) is still waiting for the CFO's Face ID.
